title: Seven states take 94% of India's FDI. Here is who gets what, and why
short: Seven states take 94% of India's FDI
dek: Foreign direct investment into India since October 2019 has gone overwhelmingly to a handful of states. The official state-wise table shows how lopsided the map is.
card: ₹27.26 lakh crore of FDI equity inflow, and Maharashtra alone took 31.5%. The state-wise numbers, explained.
sources: DPIIT: Fact Sheet on FDI Inflow, April 2000 to March 2026 (Annexure C, state-wise)
